item.description:
Being a DIK [v0.12.0] [DrPinkCake]

Overview

剧情概要

Being a DIK is a choice-driven adult Visual Novel focusing on the fun parts of college life. The game is packed with humor, sex, romance, drama and a rich story. Play as a young male attending college at B&R and guide him through the experience.

关于汉化补丁
  • AI模型：DeepSeek-V3 / DeepSeek-V3.1-Terminus
  • 翻译作者：落谦
  • 制作日期：2026-08-18
  • PS：由于AI会出现幻觉，那么文本上下文中，偶尔会出现人名翻译误差、中英文夹杂、以及突兀文风的句子。目前落谦也只能统一主要角色的人名，但难免还是会有个别遗漏，毕竟落谦只有一个人，时间和精力确实有限。至于一些小名、昵称、缩写称呼、称谓、地点、事件，以及专有名词，还有类似sister、brother这种一词多义的单词，则需要人工边玩边修正。当然，如果在统一主要角色人名时，发现了相关专有名词，也会顺手统一一下。还请大家多多谅解，总之不妨碍游玩，如果介意，还请勿玩。
  • 免死金牌：落谦的汉化补丁，无论是AI意译版本还是逐句意译版本，都远不及原文或其他大佬的汉化版本。与其他汉化大佬不同，落谦并非为了为爱发电，而是纯粹希望提升文笔，所以会加入更多文化色彩，比如网络热梗？古诗词？谚语？俗语？网文小说梗？等等？还请高抬贵手，别再阴阳怪气我了。

0.12.0

前言

叠甲 🛡️

OK啊，我们先叠个甲！怎么说呢，第三季的汉化补丁算是制作出来了，但是有个小瑕疵。什么小瑕疵呢？就是 Rooster 博客，以及角色背景的个人信息那里，有些文本是显示不了汉化的。

为什么会出现这种Bug呢？听我给你们盘一盘这个堪称“套娃”的终极难题： 最基础的原因，是游戏源代码里写的文本跟实际渲染出来的文本不一样（比如标点符号、大小写、拼写有差异）。更让人头疼的是这游戏逆天的存档继承机制。游戏不仅分 Steam 版、GOG 版，还有 F95 的学习版。如果你还打了一个外网大佬制作的 Mod，什么？！还有高手！这会产生一个极其恐怖的排列组合套娃：

  • 作者从游戏发布至今，每次更新都会修改一些语法和文本，你存了档；
  • 后来你又打了Mod，Mod作者更新时也会修改文本，你又存了档。

这导致你的旧存档里，死死地裹挟着各种不同版本的英文文本、废弃的标点和错别字！一套接一套，简直是无解的套娃！（当然，有些国内汉化大佬是直接跑源代码修改的，那种本地存档带的是中文，倒无伤大雅。）

这问题有办法解决吗？ 有！但我先声明，因为这种“套娃”存档的存在，我没有办法像做其他游戏那样“修一处而修复所有”，我只能用最笨的方法：一个个去穷举！怎么穷举？这需要你们向我反馈！请截图那个出问题的具体位置发给我，或者直接把存档发给我，我去对应着修。

其实我这人吃软不吃硬，特别好说话。遇到好几个水友，人家都非常有礼貌，你只要好好跟我说，有问题我肯定帮你弄。但如果你非常介意这些小瑕疵，又死活不愿意反馈，那我根本修不了。要是更逆天一点，玩完不反馈，还要跑去那种资源群、聊天群里疯狂吐槽我、阴阳怪气我，那我还给你改吗？我又不是傻子对吧，做也被喷，不做也被喷，那我图啥？

如果你非要用这个补丁，请截图那个出问题的具体位置发给我。所以我在开头就先叠过甲了，如果你非常介意这些小瑕疵，然后你又不反馈，那我根本修不了。要是更逆天一点，遇到问题不反馈还跑来阴阳怪气喷我，那我非常建议你不要使用我的补丁。我就是个捣鼓 AI 的半吊子，不是什么大佬，只是个小卡拉米。先叠个甲哈！

算账

释然 💔

说到这里，我们来好好算算这笔账，顺便聊聊费用的事。 其实本来，我是想开订阅的（一个月10米）做点外快来着，寻思一个月能赚个两三千也还行。结果现在我一个月连300米都没圈到，但后来想了想：算了，不加了！

为什么？不管收没收费，都要挨骂挨喷。要是收了费，那肯定被喷得更惨！万一遇到极端人士，给我打上什么乱七八糟的标签，甚至直接把我户口给开了、把我盒给开了，那我不是倒了八辈子血霉？ 我搞这些，原本就是想着帮助十几个愿意向我反馈的水友。有些老水友每次拿补丁非要打赏我，我觉得太见外了，才随便开了个“爱发电”和赞助，让大家自愿打赏。结果呢？就这一个月两三百块钱，还有人盯着我喷！

我就纳闷了，你们为啥不去喷那些搞“充电进群”的？不去喷那些把资源分卷压缩、东放一个盘西放一个盘、故意赚网盘费的人？我一没收你们网盘费，二没强买强卖。老盯着我一个人阴阳怪气干嘛？

开销

账本 📊

叠完甲，我们来盘点一下这次第三季补丁大概用了多少费用和精力（网费、电费和人力精力就不算了，只算 AI 的开销）：

  • 文本翻译：DeepSeek V3.1。 这次第三季我没有像第一二季那样用 DeepSeek V3 去跑，而是用了 V3.1。为什么？因为 V3.1 更稳定，虽然费用是 V3 的两倍，但跑出来的汉化能帮我减少很多工作量。它极少出现那种幻觉 Bug，或者恶性的“突兀文邹邹幻觉”。之前有人在某些群里疯狂吐槽我，说文本出现幻觉，还以为是我人工瞎改的。哎呀，我没办法嘛！你遇到问题不反馈，还阴阳怪气我，那游戏我肯定就不去动它了啊，我又不是傻子对不对？你好好跟我反馈，我肯定会帮你修，甚至用 V3.1 重新给你跑一次都没问题。这次《我的大学生活》这种学院/都市题材，用 V3.1 跑出来的效果非常棒，非常接地气，图文风和幻觉极少。总共算下来，Token 消耗大概在 25 块钱左右。

  • 图片精修：Codex。 这次有些图片我进行了P图处理，但我自己不会用 PS，所以我用的是 Codex 这个 AI 来弄。Codex 消耗了我 Plus 会员（约 140 元/月）周额度的 30%，大家可以自己算算这笔费用。

  • 代码与 Mod：Gemini (反重力)。 这游戏的代码特别难崩！我本来想用Replace代码替换，结果太拉胯了。后来我干脆不跟它嘻嘻哈哈了，直接上了 Gemini（反重力），让它全局修改，还写了四五个外置 Mod。虽然我把这些 Mod 都集成在补丁里了，但目前没发现什么恶性 Bug（如果有，请告诉我，我再把它们从补丁里分出来优化）。Gemini 的 Pro 会员周额度我用了大概 50%，这个消耗算比较大了，因为这几天我每天都化身“Yes工程师”让它去操作。

  • 时间成本。 大家可能不知道，今年 4 月份我做第一二季的时候，基本是纯手搓的，代码提取全靠自己写，除了文本用 AI 跑，整整耗费了一个星期的总时长（不是说每天下工作之余做两小时那种，是总时长加起来实打实的一个星期）。而这次第三季从发布到现在大概三天，刚好碰上周末，我每天花四五个小时配合 AI 搞定，总耗时可能都不超过 24 小时。

注意

避坑 ⚠️

关于 Mod 集成的情况（很重要）：

这次我没有把外网大佬制作的 Mod 本体直接集成在补丁里！大家必须自己去打那个外网大佬的 Mod，然后再配合我们的汉化补丁使用。 我们的补丁里只集成了对应 Mod 的汉化文本。为什么要这样做？就是为了避免上面提到的各种排异报错和无解的问题。

所以，如果你自己打好了一切，却发现游戏中出现了绿色的选项并且是英文的，那 100% 是我漏提取了文本，这个你必须要向我反馈了，不反馈我也没辙了，反正我是没时间玩。

重点

重置 🔄

关于第一、二季的后续重置计划（重点填坑）：

肯定有人会问，既然第三季用 V3.1 跑出来效果这么好，那第一、二季会重新优化吗？ 会的！ 我会抽个时间从头搞一下，全部换成 V3.1 重新跑一遍。

之前一二季有个毛病：当时我们把选项 Mod 直接集成到了 TL（翻译）文本里。但 TL 文本的机制是“一山不容二虎”，相同的英文文本会强制共用同一句翻译。这就导致前面剧情的选项翻译，会污染、影响到后面剧情的相同文本。那怎么解决呢？ 首先，我会用 V3.1 从头再跑一遍 AI。虽然第二季的文本量比第三季还要多一点点，估计要花个二三十块钱，而且如果用 V3 确实会便宜不少，但既然 V3.1 质量这么顶，咱们就“用优不用旧”！ 其次，一二季的 Mod 处理也会和这次第三季一样：不再集成 Mod 本体！ 必须由大家自己去打外网大佬制作的 Mod，然后我们的补丁只集成对应的汉化文本。这样就不会再导致前面那种互相污染报错的问题了。

结语

未来 🚀

最后，聊聊现在的 AI：

你们可能没概念我现在做补丁速度有多快。今年 4 月份做第一二季的时候，我纯手搓耗了一个多星期。而这次第三季，我每天花四五个小时，总耗时不到 24 小时就搞定了。 毕竟现在已经是 2026 年了，AI 这么发达。只要你充个 Pro 会员，开个 20 倍额度，甚至都不需要懂代码！只需要在路径里敲一行指令：“请帮我翻译这个文件，顺便制作出汉化补丁”，交给 AI，你自己化身“Yes工程师”一路回车确认就行了。 这需要什么门槛？只需要你的钱包够鼓，Token 足够烧！ 烧的钱越多，效果越好。我估计到了明年（2027 年），这玩意儿直接人手一个，只要有钱就能自己做。反正大家既然都在 Steam 上入了正版，肯定不缺这几个钱，缺的只是时间罢了。

总结一下，除了一些绿色选项和“终极套娃旧存档”导致的不显示中文 Bug 外，这次补丁的对话文本汉化率应该在 99.999% 左右了。如果你找不到其他汉化资源，非常想玩，可以试试我这个基于 F95 学习版制作的补丁。但如果遇到 Bug，还是那句话，希望大家能截个图或者带存档反馈一下。如果非常介意，请勿游玩；如果有一定英语基础，没有强迫症，大致能看懂，不反馈也无所谓。总之就是这样啦！

PS²必看

距离上次更新过了四五天啊，因为最近确实没空。
一是工作很忙。二是确实没时间出来做补丁。
三是因为我的汉化工具出了点小问题，这两天都用Codex或者反重力在优化那个工具，到时候更新Renpy引擎教程的时候，顺便把这个工具做的比较无脑一点嘛。现在的话是需要你解包什么乱七八糟的，到时候做一键就能翻译的那种。
总之就这样子吧，还是希望大家能够继续的向我反馈一些不显示汉化的文本。其大多文本都是一些变量文本、动态文本，这些的话都要去写一些外置mod啊，或者使用replace代码进行替换啊，又或者是一些mod的问题。
不过现在的话，补丁已经支持了两个mod，一个是后宫mod，一个是多功能mod，对应的汉化文本。

Multi ModMod

GOFILE PIXELDRAIN 这里提供一个Multi Mod，这是一位外网大佬制作的多功能模组，模组是包含选项mod、攻略mod以及作弊mod等等一些画廊mod解锁之类的。
这个mod已经更新完了，对应的汉化文本我也集成到补丁里面了。
如果你要打的话，依旧得搭配补丁使用，依旧是Game文件夹覆盖Game文件夹。
但是呢，也有可能一些文本我没有提取出来，如果显示绿色的、显示英文的，你可以向我反馈。

Harem ModMod

GOFILE PIXELDRAIN 这里提供一个Harem Mod，顾名思义啊，就是后宫线mod，原游戏是没有的，但外网有大佬拿了ChatGPT 5.6Sol制作了这样的mod。
至于功能的话，就是魔改上面那个SP多功能模组的，该有的功能都有了，只是比SP那个多了一个后宫线的。不过应该可以吧，毕竟使用了5.6 Sol比较屌的模型啊。
那怎么打呢？依旧是Game文件夹覆盖Game文件夹。
当然，这个mod也是一直在更新，所以这里提供的也是最近一次更新的版本。对应的汉化文本，也已集成到补丁中。我也不清楚什么时候发布最终版。
当然，因为是后宫线，mod作者改了很多文本，有些文本不显示汉化是正常的，你可以截图向我反馈

Sex Sound Patch¹Mod

DATANODES PIXELDRAIN VIKINGFILE 这里是一个上垒CG补丁，好像有配音了，不知道是AI配音，还是作者拿了公用素材，还是请人做了CV。
这里把解压出来的文件，然后覆盖到Game文件夹里的文件。我这里覆盖之后，然后再把原版的汉化补丁打上去，再提取一下文本，是没有出现那种新增的文本啊。
我不知道你们其他人会不会出现这种情况，如果出现的话，可能会出现有些句子显示不了汉化的，你可以向我反馈一下。
目前的话，我确实是没有太多的时间去研究这游戏，因为最近特别忙。只是有几个水友催我做这个，我才做的。
而且我每天工作都要边工作边那个边让反重力去优化，我就点那个Yes啊，我没有耗太大的精力去优化这个了。

WindowsPC

英文原版： GOFILE GOFILE² DATANODES UPLOADNOW VIKINGFILE

AI意译汉化补丁： GOFILE PIXELDRAIN

安装步骤：

  1. 下载英文原版和AI意译汉化补丁
  2. 解压英文原版压缩包文件
  3. 将汉化补丁rpa文件放入game文件夹中
  4. 启动exe游戏，选择简体中文即可
Android安卓

我也不清楚。外挂移植的第三季能不能玩？我之前试着把存档移过去，好像不太行。我建议的话还是在电脑上玩吧，如果实在要玩，或者你可以试用一下这个MTOOL或者是Joiplay模拟器。
当然的话，我记得外挂移植可以兼容小存档，不过你之前的路线全都没有了。但是这是多路线，鱼和熊掌不能得兼。所以的话还是建议在电脑上玩吧，或者你可以看一下这个帖子。

item.title: Come Home 回家
item.description:
Come Home [v1.03 Premium] [R.J. Rhodes]

Overview

剧情概要

When your father goes missing, you return home from studying abroad to help uncover clues to where he could have gone. But returning to your hometown brings back a lot of old feelings and you soon find yourself meeting new people and rekindling relationships with old friends as well. How are you supposed to focus on finding your father, when there are so many other interesting characters who all want your attention as well. You can’t just let love pass you by. Your father would understand.

Spoiler

Come Home has 20 romanceable characters, each with their own individual storyline. All romances are optional, so you can pick and choose the characters you like, ignoring the ones that you don’t. None of the romance paths are required to play through the main story. You decide how you spend your day, from focusing on schoolwork, to dating, to just hanging around the park or playing games on your computer. An in-game hint system is there for you if you get stuck, making walkthroughs unnecessary.
This is an adult game and there is a lot of sex in it. There are many scenes that will happen throughout the story, along with repeatable activities with the many characters in the game. All scenes are fully rendered and there are plenty of animations as well. Plus, any time that you’d like to see a scene again, you can replay the scene in its entirety from the gallery. There are so many interesting characters waiting for you. All you need to do is Come Home.

This tech demo will show a ton of new features and assets that I will be using going forward. Don’t expect a bunch of new content. I prioritized a strong technical foundation to build this new game on. This means I should be able to make new content my sole priority going forward. item.title: Wasteland Guardians 荒原守护者
item.description:
Wasteland Guardians [v0.9] [SenseiDaimon]

Overview

剧情概要

Wars, natural disasters, and man-made catastrophes have brought this world to ruin. Humanity split into different camps: those who still fight to survive, and those who have embraced their inner demons and descended into chaos. Only the remaining communities strive to preserve what’s left of civilization behind their high, fortified walls. But nothing is ever that simple — to earn a place there, you first have to prove your worth by serving in one of the factions: Fighters, Botanists, Lawmen, or Gifted. You play as a former Fighter from one of these communities. But fate had other plans — after witnessing your wife’s death, you withdrew from society and chose a life of seclusion with your daughter in a small cabin beyond the walls. However, your plans for a quiet life are suddenly interrupted when someone leaves a mysterious note at your doorstep.​

Season 1 - 0.15.5 完整体选项mod
关于汉化补丁
  • AI模型：DeepSeek-V3
  • 翻译作者：落谦
  • 制作日期：2026-08-06
  • PS：由于AI会出现幻觉，那么文本上下文中，偶尔会出现人名翻译误差、中英文夹杂、以及突兀文风的句子。目前落谦也只能统一主要角色的人名，但难免还是会有个别遗漏，毕竟落谦只有一个人，时间和精力确实有限。至于一些小名、昵称、缩写称呼、称谓、地点、事件，以及专有名词，还有类似sister、brother这种一词多义的单词，则需要人工边玩边修正。当然，如果在统一主要角色人名时，发现了相关专有名词，也会顺手统一一下。还请大家多多谅解，总之不妨碍游玩，如果介意，还请勿玩。
  • 免死金牌：落谦的汉化补丁，无论是AI意译版本还是逐句意译版本，都远不及原文或其他大佬的汉化版本。与其他汉化大佬不同，落谦并非为了为爱发电，而是纯粹希望提升文笔，所以会加入更多文化色彩，比如网络热梗？古诗词？谚语？俗语？网文小说梗？等等？还请高抬贵手，别再阴阳怪气我了。
落谦酱点评

游戏预览图

素图

DOWNLOAD（汉化补丁）

PS必看

好了，这游戏终于上架Steam了啊！有能力的话，大家可以去入正支持一下作者。然后我们的汉化补丁也是支持Steam版本的，包括完整体mod也都支持。总之这游戏非常好玩，我非常推荐你们玩。

不要问为什么，因为这游戏怎么说呢？作者老是更新修复一些文本和语法，导致人工去修正太浪费时间了，所以每更新一次我都得重新跑一次AI。我现在一共是跑了四次AI了，不要问为什么四次，三次是用Deepseek v3跑的，还有一次是用Deepseek 3.1。

因为之前我那个v3的API一直抽风啊，受限制请求不到，只能用3.1试了一下。哎，结果刚好跑完之后，v3又能跑了！那我肯定还是选择用v3跑吧，因为v3的话它没那么多限制啊，就是比3.1跑得更好一点。

总之的话，既然跑了这么多份翻译嘛，到时候我找个时间抽空玩一下，顺便根据这几份翻译啊好好润色一下。把那该修的专有名词啊、该修的文本啊，总之乱七八糟全都修完。到时候可能会给大家出一版“简润版”的。

不过那版简润可能会收大家一点费用啊，跟之前的月订阅一样，也是10块钱一个月。当然，订阅的话是10块钱，买断的话是两块半，就这么多。因为这游戏文本量是非常大的，跑AI的成本很高，跑一次可能就需要15块人民币。这前前后后跑了三四次了，光API的token成本就已经花了六七十了。至于电费、水费，还有搭进去的人力精力，这个就不算了，算也算不尽，这些东西是无法用金钱来衡量的。

完整体modMod

GOFILE PIXELDRAIN 这里提供一个完整体mod，有需要的可以Game文件夹覆盖Game文件夹。啊，PC、安卓、iOS都是一样的操作

其实咱们的汉化补丁也是集成了部分的选项 mod，但我还是推荐大家再去打一下。因为这游戏是多路线的啊，光靠补丁的单路线是根本没法玩的，里面有些重复的文本选项我是没加进去的。所以我非常推荐大家直接打这个“完整体 mod”！

这个完整体 mod 不仅有选项 mod，还有作弊 mod。而且原作者那个作弊 mod 做得真的很屌，你甚至可以直接在里面改那些变量。之前我做旧版本 mod 的时候，是没有去翻译那些变量的，现在让 AI 跑了一遍之后，直接都能显示中文了。

说起这个我就要吐槽了，因为我发现还是有很多水友看不懂英文，但你们看不懂又不跟我说，这让我很难办啊。我原先都默认你们有一点呃……英语的基础在那里，结果后来发现你们一个都不会，然后你们还不给我反馈！你看，这就很离谱啊！

item.description:
Bright Past [v1.006] [Kosmos Games]

Overview

剧情概要
  • Dear friends, the day has come! It is with great pleasure that I present you a demo of my new project. Some may consider it to be a remake of my very first game - “Bright Future”, that many of you liked. The new game is called “Bright Past” and is also based on the concept of an open-world sandbox with a main storyline. However, this time we are doing it on a completely different level! In the current version you can meet the main characters, learn about their background and game setting in general. As you can see in the screenshot, the game will take place in the modern world. The main character will be a girl. The genre of the project can be described as a sandbox with elements of the quest an RPG

item.title: Hard to Love 难以去爱
item.description:
Hard to Love [Act 2 v0.013] [Qori Gaming]

Overview

剧情概要
  • Near-death experience usually forces many people to reminisce about their past, bright and happy memories. So does MC, reliving his most brilliant memory - his first love. And with old wounds still open and new yet to heal, Main Character is forced to go back to his parental house and his old dysfunctional family. Being stuck there, fighting demons of past and present, he wonders about love. Why did the girl he loved abandon him and their love child? Has she ever loved him? Is she alive and still remembers him? Should he move on and try to establish something new with someone else? Maybe with a woman he always looked up to? Or with his partners or friends? Someone else entirely? Or should he focus the rest of his life on raising his daughter right? Follow the MC on his paths of uncovering truths and fixing mistakes as he tries to sort out his love life and protect his daughter in Hard to Love.​

item.title: The Red Veil 红纱
item.description:
The Red Veil [Ep.1 Final] [Raw Magic]

Overview

剧情概要
  • In The Red Veil, you face off against The Red Hand—a ruthless syndicate led by the infamous Dante Morales, known on the streets as El Diablo. They control everything, from back-alley deals to top-level politics. The city has given up. No one dares to fight back anymore… except you. As a special agent embedded deep undercover, your mission is clear: infiltrate the Red Hand, rise through its ranks, and bring it down from the inside. But this won’t be easy. Many have tried and failed. In a world where power is bought with blood and loyalty is always for sale, staying clean is nearly impossible. As you descend into the underworld—through smoky clubs, turf wars, and blurred lines between right and wrong—you’ll face choices that test who you really are. Can you stay true to your mission? Can you survive without losing yourself? Formerly known as “NSFW - A Porn Anthology”

item.title: Milfheim: The Twisted 完蛋，我被老女人包围了！
item.description:
Milfheim: The Twisted [v0.4] [Bittersweet3D]

Overview

剧情概要
  • For unknown reasons, Damian (MC) was placed in an orphanage. After spending his teenage years in foster care, he becomes a college student and returns to his hometown, Milfheim, for the first vacation of his university life.
剧情概要
  • He takes up lodging in a house owned by Helen (Heroine), planning to spend the break meeting friends and new people. But the more time Damian spends under the same roof with Helen, the more he begins to notice another face hidden behind her warm smile.
  • Milfheim, his hometown, is a beautiful city—not too big, not too small. Y et Damian starts to uncover dark corners he never noticed as a child, plunging him into confusion. He soon realizes that many of the people who shaped his early years are tangled together in a complex web…
  • Why does Helen grow uneasy whenever the past is brought up? What truths has his foster mother never spoken? And the women around Damian—what are your real feelings?
  • Desire, love, maternal instincts, friendship, envy, jealousy, anger, sorrow… A storm of emotions crashes into Damian, just as he steps into adulthood, pulling him deep into Milfheim’s hidden, forbidden secrets.

item.title: The Synthetic 合成
item.description:
The Synthetic [Ep.7] [Carbon]

Overview

剧情概要
  • Aaron[MC] is a recent high school graduate with a passion for computer science. He struggles to communicate with people, a trait exacerbated by the domineering, tense, and rule-bound nature of his “landlady”, Ariana Caldwell. Stemming from a trauma in her early years, Ariana tries to maintain a tight grip on Aaron, leading him to become even more introverted. To escape from Ariana’s overbearing presence, Aaron immerses himself in computers and starts working on an artificial intelligence he created.
Spoiler
  • Ariana sustains her life as a successful realtor. Despite her powerful exterior, she has a low tolerance for alcohol. When she drinks, she undergoes a complete transformation, becoming affectionate, tolerant, playful, and romantic. Occasionally, the effects of alcohol make her doze off on the sofa or the table, and Aaron carries her to her room. For Aaron, dealing with the two faces of Ariana is challenging. While her dominant and tense demeanor shapes his life, her intoxicated self exhibits the loving character he yearns for. This complexity in their relationship and his feelings towards her become even more intricate as the artificial intelligence he created starts pushing its limits and exhibiting unpredictable behaviors.

  • 然后我跟这位水友啊，拿了官中啊。就不上传那个AI的了。直接玩官中都行啊。官中质量很好啊，非常的用心啊。

  • PS：由于AI会出现幻觉，那么文本上下文中，偶尔会出现人名翻译误差、中英文夹杂、以及突兀文风的句子。目前落谦也只能统一主要角色的人名，但难免还是会有个别遗漏，毕竟落谦只有一个人，时间和精力确实有限。至于一些小名、昵称、缩写称呼、称谓、地点、事件，以及专有名词，还有类似sister、brother这种一词多义的单词，则需要人工边玩边修正。当然，如果在统一主要角色人名时，发现了相关专有名词，也会顺手统一一下。还请大家多多谅解，总之不妨碍游玩，如果介意，还请勿玩。
  • 免死金牌：落谦的汉化补丁，无论是AI意译版本还是逐句意译版本，都远不及原文或其他大佬的汉化版本。与其他汉化大佬不同，落谦并非为了为爱发电，而是纯粹希望提升文笔，所以会加入更多文化色彩，比如网络热梗？古诗词？谚语？俗语？网文小说梗？等等？还请高抬贵手，别再阴阳怪气我了。

落谦酱便利贴

PS
  • 这游戏也能玩，质量蛮高的。
  • 这游戏是有官中的
  • 但是呢，因为没有泄露出来学习版，有水友让我跑一个，那就跑一个吧
  • 其实我找过一位水友拿了正版的官中来着
  • 但是官中的源代码被作者删了，剩下一个反编译的。但是反编译的又做不了完整体mod，所以我也只能跑一个AI了
  • 但是呢，这游戏是比较难做的。也不算堪比我的大学生活吧，就是那个结束语那里，每一章结束那里有一个统计量
  • 那个统计量呢，是要根据引擎计算的，但是我没有玩过嘛，而且提取出来的文本，跑了AI之后还不能显示汉化，还得魔改一下源代码
  • 但是就尽量显示汉化了，有几句是显示不了的，因为得自己去拼接。源代码是会根据引擎去计算，但是文本机制是不会算的，只能读取文本
  • 所以补丁肯定是没有对应的文本的，但唯一显示不了的汉化就是那个支付美刀，那里是显示不了汉化的，因为是根据引擎实时去计算那个金额的，所以补丁里边是没有的
  • 除非我自己玩一遍，然后每一次算了多少刀，我就把对应的文本给写上去，这样子就会显示汉化。但是你觉得我有时间吗？肯定没有吧，对吧？哈哈
  • 最新版本已经有官中了，就没必要去做补丁了，终于解放了，而且自带攻略mod、选项mod
  • 但是安卓端可能没有键盘键，无法开启，可以打一个画廊mod，直接强制开启。
  • 如果PC端也打不开的话，那也可以打个画廊mod，万能的画廊mod啊，哈哈

剧情概要
  • in the Story you play as a Male Protagonist, He’s a chill guy, mid-twenties, lives alone. No pets, no girlfriend, living that bachelor life. He works at a local fast food style restaurant with his colleague, Daniela. They also happen to be living in the same apartment complex. They are bickering all the time but at least it doesn’t get too boring at work. But one day, everything changes when life takes a bad turn for Daniela and our MC, is gonna be the only one she can rely on to help her. Her apartment burns down in mysterious circumstances and just as she asks MC to crash on his couch for a while, the smoking hot Catalina moves in next door - instantly sparking a connection with MC. Overview

剧情概要
  • The exclusive district of Hillside is home to the country’s film industry and to those lucky enough to be able to afford to live there. Among them is veteran supermodel Charlotte Lloyd and her youngest daughter, Emma. You play an experienced bodyguard hired to protect the 18-year-old Emma from a stalker who has recently begun sending disturbing letters to the shy teen. But protecting her might be the easiest part of the job as you move into Charlotte’s house and live with one of the world’s most beautiful models. Will you be able to control your sexual desire and preserve your hard-earned professional reputation?​

item.title: Crowhaven 鸭巢镇
item.description:
Crowhaven [Ep.4] [Daniels K]

Overview

剧情概要
  • In Crowhaven you play as a young doctor, fresh out of his residency and eager to start a new life in a new town, doing the job you love the most. You are hired as a family doctor in a town called Crowhaven, in a brand-new clinic, working alongside two beautiful nurses (which happen to be sisters). You’re glad to get away from your old life and start fresh, leaving behind bad memories and relationships that have run their course. Here you get to meet new people, get close to them if you wish and enjoy your life…
Spoiler
  • Forbidden Trials is released in episodic chapters. Each update expands the cast, adds new scenarios, and branches the story based on player decisions. The current chapter, Playhouse, is a two-episode arc.
  • Episode 1 is available as an alpha build with 3,000+ renders.
  • Early choices affect key relationships, including whether Nina starts as Milo’s girlfriend or just a close friend, which changes how their dynamic unfolds later.

item.title: Forbidden Trials 禁忌试炼
item.description:
Forbidden Trials [v0.1] [Forbidden Trials]

Overview

剧情概要
  • SForbidden Trials follows Milo, a man stuck in a dead-end job trying to keep his life together while helping his struggling mother. When he and his companion Nina are unexpectedly selected for a high-profile reality show with a massive cash prize, it feels like a chance to finally change everything. But once the cameras start rolling, the show turns out to be less about fame and more about pressure, temptation, and people being pushed into uncomfortable and erotic situations. New contestants arrive, relationships start shifting, and what seemed simple at first quickly becomes complicated.
Spoiler
  • Forbidden Trials is released in episodic chapters. Each update expands the cast, adds new scenarios, and branches the story based on player decisions. The current chapter, Playhouse, is a two-episode arc.
  • Episode 1 is available as an alpha build with 3,000+ renders.
  • Early choices affect key relationships, including whether Nina starts as Milo’s girlfriend or just a close friend, which changes how their dynamic unfolds later.

  • God is dead; morality is a lie - After arriving in the metropolis of Solace City, a man with a shadowed past starts pulling threads that others left tangled. Threads tied to missing girls, a campus with a dark secret, and a city built of corruption and lies. With no plan but plenty of guts he starts chasing leads and turning stones. But the city doesn’t want to be questioned and so he finds himself facing greater challenges than ever before. Making allies along the way he finds himself tug between his self-bestowed responsibilities and a normal life of peace and happiness. But walking away isn’t an option anymore. There’s too much on the line and he knows that no one else will step up to the plate. How will you navigate the perils of Solace City? Will you be a merciless hunter or a virtuous savior?​

item.description:
World of Secrets [v0.6.7] [RWA Studios]

Overview

剧情概要
  • Dive into the shadowy depths of “World of Secrets,” where every choice you make carves the fate of a lone soul tangled in a web of mystery. Raised in isolation, haunted by a past shrouded in secrets, you’ll navigate a world where trust is a gamble and power lurks behind every corner. Will you rise with grit and honor, or let the seductive pull of corruption steer your path? Craft a story that’s yours alone—brimming with raw, complex characters and endless possibilities. Face trials that peel back the layers of this enigmatic figure, from gritty survival to tangled bonds with those who could be allies or enemies. Uncover a labyrinth of hidden truths, where the stakes are high and the shadows run deep. NTR paths are fully optional—your journey, your rules.

  • 还行，这游戏也是能玩的，其实这游戏是有关中的，但是Steam上官中不支持DLC，打了DLC会报错，所以我就跑了一个AI
  • 而且这游戏是自带攻略的，就在DLC那边可以开关。
  • 还有这个游戏跟U4iaI一样，每一章结束会有结束语。但是结束语是通过引擎去计算的。
  • 尽管已经把所有文本提取出来了，但TL没有这个计算的机制。所以应该有几句文本是显示不了汉化的，得自己手动拼接计算然后贴上去。
  • 但是我又没有时间玩。等有空再修复吧，还有一些变量文本啊，也是显示英文。总之就这样子吧，有空就修复。

item.title: Shifting Stars 流转星辰
item.description:
Shifting Stars [v0.2] [Story Machine Studios]

Overview

剧情概要
  • Leon Armstrong is a bio-mechanical engineer for a weapons defense company, Genesis Biotech. Growing up in a military family he is the first not to join the military, opting to focus on martial arts and bio-technology. He finds himself crossing unexpected paths with the enigmatic Danica Thoreson. Two seemingly different people drawn together and thrust into a corporate conspiracy. As they grow closer and their worldviews are challenged they must face a dangerous future. Are we destined by fate or is it truly free will that drives the future forward?​

item.title: Etlina's Principle 艾特琳娜的规则
item.description:
Etlina’s Principle [v0.05.0 Public] [PipPoad]

Overview

剧情概要
  • Etlina’s Principle is a mature, adult game with VN style gameplay and focuses on the theme of the symbyote\living suit. Humanity discovered a new type of living organism - a symbiotic life form called “Nox Limax,” which gave the hosts incredible powers. But one year after the successful tests on humans, something happened that seriously changed the world.
Spoiler
  • At some point, people began to turn into slimy latex-like creatures. The city’s environment and its neighborhood, animals, humans, and fauna changed drastically, changing the land into a perilous place, like an alien planet with its flora and fauna. You are a member of the HOWL Squad - a particular military unit designed to perform tasks in conditions of increased danger. On your way, you will meet many local inhabitants, most of whom may not be as horrible as they are told they will be. On your way, you will find a lot of friends and enemies. In the end, it will be up to you to decide who is the real threat. Who will you choose to support, and what possible results will that have on the people you care about and the fate of humanity itself?

Unravel the mystery of why you were given this property and the implications of owning it! All while being joined by a bunch of cuties along the way!
Spoiler
  • Paracosmic Reality is based on a “Paracosm”. A form of alternate reality that one can slip into when dealing with stressful situations. Conversely to its namesake, in this story, an alternate reality is slipping into our own! As the story progresses, more and more fantasy elements will find their way into the world. item.title: Meridia 子午线
item.description:
Meridia [v0.2.0] [ScriptVeil Games]

Overview

剧情概要
  • Step into the life of Elly West, an 18-year-old college freshman beginning her transformative journey at the mysterious Meridian Heights University. What begins as a clean slate and a full-ride scholarship slowly twists into something much more complicated, with secrets and hidden agendas tucked beneath MHU’s polished charm. As Elly, you’ll navigate the delicate balance between maintaining the values instilled by your loving adoptive family and embracing the temptations of independence, romance, and self-discovery. Every choice you make will shape not only your relationships with classmates and professors, but also your very identity as you transform from a sheltered small-town girl into the woman you’re destined to become.​

Details

游戏信息

游戏玩法

沙盒视觉小说

建模引擎

Daz Studio

运行引擎

Ren’Py

游戏画风

欧美风

当前版本

0.2.0

发行日期

2026-06-12

Developer（入正地址）

Twitter Patreon Discord

落谦酱便利贴

PS
  • 我一看这游戏才0.2，应该文本不多吧，很快就能搞好了，最多一个小时对吧？
  • 然后搞了我七八个小时。早知道这样，我去搞那个信仰之跃，还有我的大学生活第三季去了。
  • 因为太多那种犄角旮旯的文本了，我至少提取了三四十个文件，就是那个破手机里边藏了那么多文本，有什么贷款的，有那种博客的，还有乱七八糟的，什么学院打卡的，哎，看都看不懂。不过也是全都提取出来了，但是呢？
  • 因为作者没有考虑多语言性，所以有些文本不是固定的，而是实时变量通过引擎计算的。而TL的文本机制只有读取的功能。那我又没有时间玩，所以有些句子是不显示汉化的，得自己手动去算，算完之后再贴上去，这是特别耗费精力的，我是不太愿意搞的。
  • 哎，真麻烦死了，下次更新也不会搞了，必须得狠狠吐槽一波
  • 只能说，我超威，你做游戏，你做好一点的呀，那代码写好一点啊，能不能考虑一下多语言性啊？
  • 抛开这些不谈啊，这建模还是挺OK的，虽然没多少CG，BGM也是挺好的，渲染也挺OK的。
  • 而且还支持两种模式，就是像魔法学院那样子，也可以选沙盒，也可以选视觉小说。
  • 我的建议的话，直接玩视觉小说吧。如果你想折腾一下的话，可以玩一下这个沙盒模式。
  • 沙盒模式就是多了一个任务系统，还有一个手机，就像我的大学生活那样子，有个博客，反正UI做的比我的大学生活好看。
  • 唯一的缺点是有些文本是显示不了汉化的，希望作者能够自己出一个官中吧，到时候做个mod就行了。反正这种硬骨头的，谁爱搞谁搞去吧
博文更新日志
日期 更新详情 当前状态
2026.06.19 08:00 0.2.0：AI意译汉化补丁 ✅
关于汉化补丁
  • AI模型：DeepSeek-V3
  • 翻译作者：落谦
  • 制作日期：2026-06-19
  • PS：由于AI会出现幻觉，那么文本上下文中，偶尔会出现人名翻译误差、中英文夹杂、以及突兀文风的句子。目前落谦也只能统一主要角色的人名，但难免还是会有个别遗漏，毕竟落谦只有一个人，时间和精力确实有限。至于一些小名、昵称、缩写称呼、称谓、地点、事件，以及专有名词，还有类似sister、brother这种一词多义的单词，则需要人工边玩边修正。当然，如果在统一主要角色人名时，发现了相关专有名词，也会顺手统一一下。还请大家多多谅解，总之不妨碍游玩，如果介意，还请勿玩。
  • 免死金牌：落谦的汉化补丁，无论是AI意译版本还是逐句意译版本，都远不及原文或其他大佬的汉化版本。与其他汉化大佬不同，落谦并非为了为爱发电，而是纯粹希望提升文笔，所以会加入更多文化色彩，比如网络热梗？古诗词？谚语？俗语？网文小说梗？等等？还请高抬贵手，别再阴阳怪气我了。

item.title: Moonlight 月光
item.description:
Moonlight [Ep.3 v0.03.10] [BigBat_Productions]

Overview

剧情概要
  • Moonlight is a thought-provoking adult visual novel set in a dystopian near-future where technology and humanity collide in unexpected ways. In the world of Moonlight, Neural Implants (NIs) have become an integral part of daily life, controlling everything from communication to dopamine production. A new app has recently entered the market, allowing people to escape into a virtual world while their bodies are controlled by AI and sent out to work. But not everyone is content with this tech-dominated society. You’ll step into the shoes of a Detective, a weathered investigator driven by personal loss, as he unravels the dark secrets behind a mysterious death. As you dive deeper into the investigation, you’ll find yourself entangled in a web of leads, each more complex and dangerous than the last. Expect a game rich in story, with complex characters, emotional twists and turns, and passionate scenes.

item.title: What We Left Behind 我们留下的印记
item.description:
What We Left Behind [v0.0.2] [Dreamscape Games]

Overview

剧情概要
  • Often in life, it’s those flashpoint moments that cause us to reflect on the decisions we’ve made, the directions we’re going, and the things that are truly important. For Kareem, a failed promotion attempt and the death of his closest friend; for Nami, the reality of her failing artistic endeavors and a family legacy she never wanted as her own. Two strangers reckoning with pivotal forks, whose chance meeting will intertwine the webs of their lives forever. What lessons in love will one teach? Will it hurt? Will it heal? Will it push them towards or away from the paths they were meant to take? Help them choose what must be left behind, that they may grow into whom they’re suppose to be.​

  • The life of a short man is difficult, even more so having a spectacular girlfriend and being surrounded by bad people. item.title: All Things Change 万物皆变
item.description:
All Things Change [v0.1.98RP] [ALDOR]

Overview

剧情概要
  • Writer’s block slowly forced you to stop writing. Success used to stick to you like a curse, but now you’ve decided to move on to something else. After many years, you decide to return to your hometown to clear your head, and take up the position of Director of the local academy, at the request of an old friend. Accompanied by Linda, the young woman you have been raising for many years, face a past you have tried to forget. Relive your past successes or make new friends, the choice is yours. You will also have to manage the academy and learn a few secrets. Young women eager to help you with your many tasks will not hesitate to use their charms.​

item.title: Finding Cloud 9 寻找极乐
item.description:
Finding Cloud 9 [v0.9.6] [Onyx Decadence]

Overview

剧情概要
  • Finding Cloud 9 is a slow-burn, story-driven adult visual novel about a college guy whose promising summer takes a dangerous turn when he’s coerced into drug production to protect the people close to him. As he juggles a normal life with a criminal one, intimate relationships, desire, and money begin to blur his sense of right and wrong. His naivety is slowly broken with each new situation, each new insight as he slowly becomes more and more realistic about his situation and every choice he makes pushes him closer to becoming either the man he believes he is… or someone who learns to ruthlessly justify crossing every line. This is a story about temptation, escalation, and the cost of wanting more. Whether you find your Cloud 9, or lose yourself chasing it, is up to you.

item.description:

  • 5 years before Shadows of Desire, Yuria took a long trip from the USA to the Congo with her husband Alvin and daughter Miley for work, Alvin’s job was in great demand in one of Congo’s most unfortunate shelters, where there is one particular refugee who is a bit… crazy… He will become obsessed with Yuria the moment he sees her, will Yuria be able to realize the real intentions of the crazy guy? And what if it is Yuria who becomes obsessed with him? Who knows, maybe Yuria’s job as a psychologist will be her downfall.​

item.description:

Overview

剧情概要
  • MY GIRL LOVES HANDCUFFS is a kinky adult dating sim with a dash of mystery. After escaping her crazed, cult-following parents, your girl begins sleepwalking—stomping through your tiny apartment and waking you every night. Desperate for rest, the two of you buy a pair of handcuffs to keep her in bed. But to both your surprise, they bring far more than just peaceful nights. What follows is a lust-driven descent into your wildest fantasies. A guy. A girl. A pair of handcuffs. And a lot of kinky sex.​

item.title: Game of Hearts 红心游戏
item.description:
Game of Hearts [Steam R1] [SparkHG]

Overview

剧情概要
  • The next successor war dawns on Earth. A seat at the high table, once governed by a powerful demon, went vacant for unknown reasons. With a chance at a position of control, other lesser demons roused from their respective places, each with an aspiration of reaching the apex of power
Spoiler
  • But you, an outsider, knew nothing about it. A rude awakening haunted your place in the form of an armed assailant, and you’d be dead if it wasn’t due to a man who called himself your father.
  • Thrown into a different life, you must gather power from gaining loyal followers;
  • (mainly)women beguiled by your irresistible demonic charm. Seduce and corrupt your way into a stable life.
  • And then… maybe, just maybe, you might rise to the top.

item.description:
SnowStorm [v0.12] [GleenX Studio]

Overview

剧情概要
  • Far in the North, surrounded by lakes, mountains, and forests, three clans are coexisting in the strange village of Njardarheimr: the Hvitr Ulfr (White Wolves), the Myrk Hrafn (Dark Ravens), and the Bloba Bjorn (Bloody Bears).
  • Those clans are so different, nothing seems to bring them together, but when facing greater danger, they become the mighty Vikings. This epic adventure in the Northern lands will let you explore the ancient Norse mysteries, make important decisions, fight for your survival and meet a lot of beautiful girls. Whatever the path you choose, only the most determined survive.

item.description:

Overview

剧情概要
  • A young and ambitious man arrives in Domino Beach, the sunny city of his dreams, hoping to start a new life. But from the very beginning, nothing goes according to plan: he loses his job and then gets evicted from his apartment. By a twist of fate, he gets a chance to prove himself and join the team of beach lifeguards, with tryouts happening in a week. Will he be able to overcome this challenge, surrounded by so many temptations: beautiful girls, daredevil surfers, wild parties, and an ocean of alcohol?​

item.title: Echoes of 2990 2990的回声
item.description:
Echoes of 2990 [Ch.2 0.2.3] [AADev]

Overview

剧情概要
  • The year is 2990. You’re a rebellious punk fresh out of high school — all defiance and devil-may-care charm — until one punch changes everything. It was supposed to be just another fight, another middle finger to the system. But your opponent? Your teacher. His fist didnât just knock you down — it knocked something loose. Now you’re seeing flashes of the future. This isn’t a gift. It’s a glitch in reality. And it’s your ticket onto a high-stakes deep-space mission, alongside a crew of sassy, seductive women.
  • Destination: Andromeda
  • Mission: Forge a new world, connect with alien civilizations, and carve your legacy — as a king, a conqueror… or the heart of a harem. The story is yours to shape.​

item.title: House of Hearts 红心之屋
item.description:
House of Hearts [Ep.2 P.1] [SparkHG]

Overview

剧情概要
  • The next successor war dawns on Earth. A seat at the high table, once governed by a powerful demon, went vacant for unknown reasons. With a chance at a position of control, other lesser demons roused from their respective places, each with an aspiration of reaching the apex of power
Spoiler
  • But you, an outsider, knew nothing about it. A rude awakening haunted your place in the form of an armed assailant, and you’d be dead if it wasn’t due to a man who called himself your father.
  • Thrown into a different life, you must gather power from gaining loyal followers;
  • (mainly)women beguiled by your irresistible demonic charm. Seduce and corrupt your way into a stable life.
  • And then… maybe, just maybe, you might rise to the top.

item.title: Chasing Sunsets 追逐落日
item.description:
Chasing Sunsets [v1.10a] [Stone Fox Studios]

Overview

剧情概要
  • Chasing Sunsets follows the story of step-siblings reconnecting and dealing with the fallout of their parents’ unexpected deaths. As the story progresses, they will cooperate (or compete) with each other to discover the secrets of their parents’ success in business and in love. The player’s choices will determine both how the game ends, and whom he finishes it with. Explore majestic Tonalu Island and the motivations of the tempting ladies encountered along the way…But don’t lose sight of what you’re there for!​

item.title: Origin Story 起源故事（嘿炮纠插队）
item.description:
Origin Story [S2 v0.9.3] [JDOR]

Overview

剧情概要
  • Taking place twenty years after the Metagen-92 virus – aka the “Superflu” – has swept the world and rendered many of its adult population superpowered or mutated, Origin Story follows MC (name customizable), a seemingly normal nineteen-year-old who in any other universe would be a popular and attractive prospect for most girls. But in this universe, his ability hasn’t manifested yet. Shunned by most of his meta-gifted peers, MC finds himself a hapless virgin on the lower rung of his school’s social ladder, with only a few misfit friends by his side.
Spoiler
  • Following the death of his parents when he was just a baby, his upbringing in the system was overseen and financially supported by their close friend Parker Samson, the affluent and influential co-owner of the lead organization behind Metagen research and development of the now ineffective Metagen Vaccine. Having recently moved in with the beautiful Parker, and her equally beautiful daughter Riley, MC finds the perpetual state of arousal that comes with the burden of his virginity even more challenging.
  • When MC is targeted and violently attacked for reasons unknown to him, The Sisterhood – a government-backed team of celebrity superheroines and sex icons - comes to his aid. While under their care, The Sisterhood immediately recognize his worth and hidden charms.
  • MC soon finds himself juggling his school life, his suddenly blossoming relationships with the women he keeps close, his curious involvement with The Sisterhood and one big secret that could determine whether this is the origin story of a hero, or a villain.

item.description:
Steps of Debauchery [Ep.5.1] [Fooxied]

Overview

剧情概要
  • Follow the steps of Riley, a girl who moves from a small town to the city to help her husband, Mike, pursue his dreams. While Mike is busy with his bar, Riley supports him wholeheartedly and often puts others’ well-being above her own. This leads her into unexpected situations, where she discovers more about her true self and deepest desires.
  • She explores her sexuality in college and unravels her fantasies, takes on the role of a waitress at the bar, engages in activities with an elderly neighbor, streams adventures with his grandson and that’s just the tip of the mountain. Riley’s world is opening wide in front of her, and she waits for you to explore it.

Overview

剧情概要
  • Student life is perhaps the most vivid, colorful, and memorable period of life for many of us. You start your adult life, feel unlimited possibilities, make a lot of new acquaintances. “University of Problems” is just about it. An ordinary guy from an ordinary family unexpectedly enters one of the best universities in the country. What could be better, right? Lots of opportunities, constant parties, attractive girls, complete freedom of choice. In a word: real adult life. But everything is not as rosy as it may seem at first glance…​

item.title: A.O.A. Academy AOA学院
item.description:
A.O.A. Academy [Ch.5 Gold] [TLGGAMES]

Overview

剧情概要
  • June 2020, the month after your father died. He was the only motivation for you to stay in the old town. Now.. You didn’t know where else to go or what else to do. Due to his bad heart, you decided to take care of him full time, causing you to drop out of high-school to focus on the farm.
Spoiler
  • There’s absolutely nothing else left for you here… Until one day, you found a letter from the A.O.A academy, claiming that you have been accepted into their academy. This surprised you, since you’ve never attempted to enroll in any academy. Not only that, this letter also contained the number of your old friend, Ashley. Determine to face your new future , you headed to the A.O.A Academy.

item.title: I Was a Teenage Vampire Rebuild 我是少年吸血鬼
item.description:
I Was a Teenage Vampire Rebuild [v0.8.1b] [FatalMasterpiece]

Overview

剧情概要
  • It’s summer, 1989. Class is almost out, and your last chance to make memories is slipping away. You’ve got plans: get a job, buy a car, maybe even find a girlfriend. But something’s wrong in Silver Lake. People are disappearing. Shadows move where they shouldn’t. And when your friend goes missing, the mystery hits home. Something in the darkness is waiting for you. Something old. This summer, growing up might just get you killed.
Spoiler
  • I Was a Teenage Vampire is a story driven visual novel inspired by retro adventure games, 80s horror flicks, and teen sex comedies of the 1980s. Set in smalltown America during the final days of class, you’ll navigate friendships, romances, and the strange forces awakening beneath the surface of Silver Lake. With branching paths, player choice, and characters who remember how you treat them, your actions shape the story and its outcome. This version has been completely rebuilt in Ren’Py.

item.description:
Summer Crush [Ep.8 v1.0.3] [Wet n’ Juicy Games]

Overview

剧情概要
  • 《夏日恋情》是一部面向成年人的视觉小说。故事情节将完全取决于你做出的选择。你将扮演一个青年，一个已经计划好他的乏味成年生活的青年。现在，他正在等待夏天的结尾。可能会出现什么转机呢？

运行引擎

游戏画风

欧美风

当前版本

Episode 8 - 1.03

发行日期

2026-02-07

Changelog

更新日志
  • The eighth and final episode of Summer Crush is now available. New scenes, animations, achievements, and music await you. Well, business as usual!
  • I realize I’ve been dragging my feet. In May 2025, when I sat down to develop the final episode, I thought I’d have it all finished in time for the game’s third anniversary, November 25th. And now, on November 24th, I’m looking at the game’s progress and realizing there’s still a ton of work to do: the animations aren’t ready, some renders aren’t finished, the music is missing, and there’s no sign of any translations into other languages. This post is partly for myself – if you’re the only one responsible for everything, don’t set deadlines! You’ll never make it…
  • Nevertheless, I apologize. The game was supposed to be finished sooner, but I couldn’t do it before. But now it’s done!
  • I hope you enjoy it. Thank you for devoting your precious time to my little game.

item.description:
Breeze of Passion [v9.01 Extra] [L7team]

Overview

剧情概要
  • 《Breeze of Passion》是一款成人游戏。你扮演一名年轻小伙，搬到海边小镇，协助复兴一家酒店。这部视觉小说满是漂亮女孩、火辣 MILF 和意想不到的剧情反转，并配有高质量画面与劲爆动画。

Details

游戏信息

游戏玩法

沙盒视觉小说

建模引擎

Daz Studio

运行引擎

Ren’Py

游戏画风

欧美风

当前版本

9.01 Extra

发行日期

2025-05-14

Changelog

更新日志
  • Hey there, everyone!
  • We are overjoyed to finally be able to present you with the new big expansion for Breeze of Passion — Deep Inspection!
  • This is not just another game update, but a standalone story sequel with a huge amount of content!
  • We worked very hard to make it special and give you the opportunity to be with your favorite characters again in the vortex of events that awaits you!
  • When it comes to this expansion, we definitely didn’t waste time.
  • It features about 5300(!!!) new images and tons and tons of animations, including full-length mocap pole dances of various girls.
  • We’ve gotten access to XSens motion capture equipment, including StretchSense Studio Pro gloves. We are currently experimenting with it and trying to figure out how it can improve the quality of our games.
  • If you didn’t already know, half of our team consists of girls. Which means they take part in creating many of the scenes you see in the game. Also, a lot of mocap animations in this update were made by the same girls
  • At the same time, we can proudly say that we do not use AI in our creative process. For example, the OST, among many other things, was licensed from real composers.
  • Absolutely everything you see in the world created by L7team is produced by living and breathing people, who love their craft and try very hard to make sure you have a lot of fun with the game!
  • Next on the menu is the final update of MILFs of Sunville.
  • We are already starting to work on it.
  • But don’t you worry. Just like with Breeze of Passion, you can look forward to more unforgettable and amazing content to be added for that game, even after that.
  • By supporting us, you help preserve the community of people who share your passions and work hard to make you a little happier ❤
  • Enjoy the Game!

Developer（入正地址）
